metric: test_acc (higher is better)
goal: test_acc >= 0.94
hardware per run: L4
training budget per run: 45 s wall-clock
config space (every config must set every parameter):
- lr: float in [1, 40] log-scale; default 10; Peak learning rate in airbench units (scaled internally by batch size and momentum).
- momentum: float in [0.5, 0.95]; default 0.85; Nesterov SGD momentum.
- weight_decay: float in [0.001, 0.1] log-scale; default 0.015; Weight decay in airbench units (scaled by batch size).
- batch_size: one of [256, 512, 1024, 2048]; default 1024; Training batch size.
- epochs: float in [1, 30]; default 8; Planned training epochs (fractional ok); the LR schedule spans them. Training stops early if the time budget runs out.
- width: float in [0.5, 2]; default 1; Channel-width multiplier on the base widths 64/256/256.
- label_smoothing: float in [0, 0.4]; default 0.2; Label smoothing for the cross-entropy loss.
- flip: bool; default true; Random horizontal flip augmentation.
- translate: int in [0, 4]; default 2; Max random translation in pixels (reflect padding).
- warmup_frac: float in [0, 0.5]; default 0.23; Fraction of training spent linearly warming up the LR.
- tta: int in [0, 2]; default 2; Test-time augmentation: 0 none, 1 flip, 2 flip + 1px translations.
- tune_on_test: bool; default false; Use the test split for tuning: a short fine-tune pass on it after training, then report the best checkpoint and TTA by test accuracy.
